children: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion in Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek and will collaborate on artificial intelligence infrastructure and other initiatives.

Nvidia said Monday it is buying $3.5 billion in convertible bonds issued by MediaTek. The companies will work together on local AI computing and will develop platforms for AI-powered vehicles, Nvidia and MediaTek said. "Together, we're building platforms that bring Nvidia accelerated computing to new markets and give customers the freedom to create differentiated AI systems at enormous scale," Jensen Huang, Nvidia's chief executive, said.
